ventilation_reason_outside_cleaner: The air outside is cleaner than in the room (by the model).
ventilation_reason_outside_worse: There is no less dust outside than in the room (by the model).
ventilation_reason_outside_dirty: The air outside is bad (by the model).
ventilation_reason_no_gain: The gain would be too small.
ventilation_reason_comfort: It is too cold or too hot outside for an open window.
ventilation_reason_already_good: The air in the room is already good.
ventilation_reason_forecast_better: The forecast says the street will be cleaner soon.
ventilation_reason_no_outdoor_data: There is no data on the dust outside.
ventilation_reason_no_indoor_data: The room sensor is not sending data.
ventilation_inside: PM2.5 dust in the room, µg/m³
ventilation_model_note: Dust outside is a model estimate, not a measurement (the street kit has no dust sensor).
ventilation_prior_note: The speed of air exchange is a cautious value from the literature: it has not been measured in this room yet.
ventilation_disclaimer: The advice is not medical advice.
